description: Search recently cached tee times for up to 50 selected courses on one date. A cache miss is not proof of no availability. After a miss, retry with refresh=true and at most three course IDs to request fresh inventory.

date.description: Local date in YYYY-MM-DD format, within the next 31 days

refresh.description: Refresh missing or stale inventory for at most three selected courses.

name: search_tee_times
